effects.instruction: Narrator only: if the player character uses their Unstable Quirk this turn beyond a light touch, it comes out one step bigger or wider than they asked, never exactly to size, with one small visible side effect (a scorch mark, a cracked tile, a gust that knocks something over). Show it on the page. A clean or better result means the goal is reached, not that the size was controlled: it still overshoots. Never have the PC throttle or hold back on their own; only the player decides that.
